webster.text: Injurious; hurtful; causing loss or damage.

example.quote: There never was any legislative assembly without a discretionary power of concealing important transactions, the publication of which might be detrimental to the community.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 14, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
